function text(r){if(typeof r?.output_text==='string')return r.output_text;for(const x of(r?.output||[]))for(const c of(x?.content||[]))if(typeof c?.text==='string')return c.text;return null} function parse(t){if(!t)return null;const s=t.replace(/^```(?:json)?\s*/i,'').replace(/\s*```$/,'').trim();try{return JSON.parse(s)}catch{}const a=s.indexOf('{'),b=s.lastIndexOf('}');if(a>=0&&b>a){try{return JSON.parse(s.slice(a,b+1))}catch{}}return null} if($json.error)throw new Error(`critic API failed: ${$json.error.message||$json.error}`); const c=parse(text($json)); if(!c||!['pass','revise','block'].includes(c.verdict))throw new Error('critic contract failed'); const src=$('Build Critic').item.json; return [{json:{...src,critic:c}}];

const payload={model:$json.model,instructions:'You are the independent arbiter in a bounded multi-specialist deliberation. Return STRICT JSON only with keys summary_markdown,risk_level,requires_human_approval,confidence,verification,remaining_uncertainties. verification and remaining_uncertainties are arrays; risk_level is low|moderate|high|critical; confidence is 0..1.',input:JSON.stringify({request_id:$json.request_id,task:$json.task,context:$json.context||{},candidate:$json.candidate||{},adversarial_review:$json.critic}),reasoning:{effort:'high'},max_output_tokens:3200,store:false}; return [{json:{...$json,arbiter_payload:payload}}];

function text(r){if(typeof r?.output_text==='string')return r.output_text;for(const x of(r?.output||[]))for(const c of(x?.content||[]))if(typeof c?.text==='string')return c.text;return null} function parse(t){if(!t)return null;const s=t.replace(/^```(?:json)?\s*/i,'').replace(/\s*```$/,'').trim();try{return JSON.parse(s)}catch{}const a=s.indexOf('{'),b=s.lastIndexOf('}');if(a>=0&&b>a){try{return JSON.parse(s.slice(a,b+1))}catch{}}return null} if($json.error)throw new Error(`arbiter API failed: ${$json.error.message||$json.error}`); const a=parse(text($json)); if(!a||typeof a.summary_markdown!=='string'||!['low','moderate','high','critical'].includes(a.risk_level))throw new Error('arbiter contract failed'); const src=$('Parse Critic').item.json; return [{json:{ok:true,specialist:'deliberation',request_id:src.request_id,summary_markdown:a.summary_markdown,risk_level:a.risk_level,requires_human_approval:a.requires_human_approval===true,confidence:Number(a.confidence||0),verification:Array.isArray(a.verification)?a.verification:[],remaining_uncertainties:Array.isArray(a.remaining_uncertainties)?a.remaining_uncertainties:[],review:src.critic,primary_candidate:src.candidate}}];
